crossRefs.note: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship…

translations.web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
translations.bsb: Do not make friends with an angry man, and do not associate with a hot-tempered man,
translations.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
translations.asv: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go:
